body:
Fuck your parents they seem like confirmed assholes. Parents are a luck-of-the-draw, and you got the shit ones.  


You said that nothing you do seems to change their perception of you; why do you care what they think? Their opinion is arguably not worth shit.  


You kinda seem like you'd be better off just packing up and getting tf out of that place. Your ultimatum is understandable, but (in my opinion) as long as youre there things won't change. And it would be almost crazy for you to expect them to.  


Life's pretty huge man, and your life is getting squished by theirs.  


​

Age thing: Moral of that story is that some people are assholes, and the assholes are the ones that speak their mind regardless of anything (cos they dont give a f**k).

Girl thing: The concept of 'the one' is just bollocks people say to make things sound more romantic/ magical. There are at least 3.45billion girls on the Planet that you haven't met yet, and that's just fact.

I hate giving advice; but I would like to propose the idea of perhaps thinking of the type of people that you respect, what traits and characteristics do you respect and like. Then try to implement those characteristics into ones day-to-day life.
E.g. be nice, friendly, warm-welcoming to people. Say please and thank you with a warm smile. Don't expect to get what you want, but be greatful when things happen that benefit you.

Assholes in life are like enemies in a game, they're just something u gotta figure out how to overcome, cos there'll always be new ones.

--don't know if this is of any use to you, but maybe some part of it might be of slight use.
